dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Single, thin, high-contrast white horizontal band visible across the greater coverts.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Thin, distinct pale gray-white edges are visible along the outer webs of the folded flight feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Small, irregular yellowish-white patch visible on the posterior neck/nape region.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Distinct and sharp linear boundary between the black crown and the olive-green mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Large, high-contrast white auricular (cheek) patch completely enclosed by black plumage.
